title: I Spent 4 Years Farming on Weekends. Here Are 7 Things to Know Before Starting Your Own Organic Farm
summary: For years, Deepak Sabharwal knew food largely from the other side of the table. Farming was something he spent time doing on weekends, at his family’s farms in Pushkar, Rajasthan. Then one day, he noticed the pesticides being used on his own farm.

title: RSS at 100 – Vijayadashmi Utsav; Century of service and reverence
summary: Dr KB Hedgewar founded the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) as an organisation with a difference. Its distinctive mode of functioning has often made it difficult for those accustomed to other organisational traditions to understand the Sangh at the beginning. The RSS conception of the Hindu nation and Hindutva is broad-based. Hindutva, in its understanding, is not a religio-political concept but a socio-cultural construct.
